ruleDefinitions.name: Potential SAM Database Dump
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of files that look like exports of the local SAM (Security Account Manager)

sequences.query: ((file_path = RGX("\\\\Temp\\\\sam$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\sam\\\.sav$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\Intel\\\\sam$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\sam\\\.hive$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\Perflogs\\\\sam$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\ProgramData\\\\sam$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\sam$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\sam$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\sam$") OR file_path = RGX("\\_ShadowSteal\\\.zip$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\Documents\\\\SAM\\\.export$") OR file_path = RGX("\\:\\\\sam$")) OR (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\hive\\_sam\\_.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\sam\\\.save.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\sam\\\.export.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\\\~reg\\_sam\\\.save.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\sam\\_backup.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\sam\\\.bck.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\sam\\\.backup.*")))
